_about: Real cricketers available as Live PvP cards. Facts only: every number carries its format and the sources it was checked against. Game ratings are NOT stored here - src/engine/pvp/realCards.ts derives them from these figures with a published formula, and they are game design values, not official statistics. Unknown facts are null, never guessed. To add a player, add an entry here, label their photo in zip-labels.json, and run `npm run pvp:assets`.

players.name: Lasith Malinga
players.statusNote: Announced retirement from all forms of cricket on 14 September 2021.

achievements.text: Captained Sri Lanka to the 2014 ICC World Twenty20 title
Five international hat-tricks (three in ODIs, two in T20Is)
Took 100 or more wickets in all three international formats

verification.notes: Primary pages (ESPNcricinfo, ICC, Wikipedia) could not be fetched from the build environment's network; figures come from search-result summaries of those pages. Batting figures were not collected and are null. Batting hand and bowling style also match the Cricsheet-derived squads in src/data/real/eras.
